mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 5.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate housing sector contraction that reduces consumer spending and economic momentum, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 100 (INDPRO) during manufacturing sector slowdowns signals reduced corporate output and earnings pressure, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO remains below 100 for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers monetary policy tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising employment trend (PAYEMS above 144,000 thousand) indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 144,000 thousand.

mechanism_narrative: In strong consumer spending environments (RSAFS > 450,000 million dollars), concurrent housing starts (HOUST) increases signal robust demand for goods and services, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 450000 and HOUST increases for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and unemployment rate increases (UNRATE) indicate dual sector stress in manufacturing and labor markets, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises for two consecutive months.
